facts.fact: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Cooperatives describes the Uganda National Bureau of Standards (UNBS) as the national standards body, overseen by a 10th National Standards Council, and says the Council reported 551 new standards developed in FY2025/26 (none identified as information technology or data).

note: No certification fact: the UNBS certification stated (enterprises certified rose from 501 to 1,270; Quality Mark) is product certification and the document names no information technology or data standard.
